items.question: What toll-free number should you call to ask the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security (ICP) about UAE visa issuance, types and validity?
items.fact: ICP toll-free enquiry number for visa issuance and validity

items.question: Which authority should you use to track a visa application if you applied for a visa to Dubai?
items.gold: General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs-Dubai
items.fact: Dubai visa applications tracked through GDRFA-Dubai, not ICP
